'''Midtown District''' was a district in the [[District 1327|Breaktown]] on [[Zakuul]]. In [[3631 BBY]] [[Senya Tirall]] and [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] passed the district during their search for the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Midtown District appears as an area on Zakuul in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
